LanguageData.RatkinQL_PeirinCh2Tree_Report: Walnut returns, looking ragged—trouble has caught up with her.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch2_Greeting: Walnut appears at your door again, her pack askew and a thin sheen of sweat on her brow. She tries a grin at {Interviewer_labelShort}, but it falls flat. "Hey. Uh… I'm in a bit of a mess. A big one."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch2_Detail1: "Remember those Warlord boys? They've got a debt-collection team on my tail. They set up camp not far from here—blocked my whole route." She rubs her arm, voice tight.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch2_Detail2: "And I'm tapped out. All my goods are tied up, and I can't move 'em without getting through that checkpoint. I'm… stuck." She swallows hard, pride visibly warring with desperation.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch2_OptLend: Lend her coin to tide her over (80 silver)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch2_OptFight: Clear out the Warlord camp for her
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch2_OptExploit: Buy her entire stock at rock-bottom price (10 silver)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch2_OptBack: Back to the matter at hand
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch2_FarewellWarm: Walnut's eyes rim red. She blinks hard, voice breaking. "I… won't forget this. Not ever. Thank you." She grips her pack straps tight, shoulders steadier than when she arrived.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch2_FarewellCold: Walnut forces a thin smile, shoulders slumped. "Right. I'll… figure something out. Thanks for… listening." She turns, steps heavy, tail dragging in the dust.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peirin_Ch2_MsgExploit: Walnut shoves the last of her goods into your hands. Her voice is flat. "There. All yours." She leaves without another word.
